tests.name: New user can sign up and lands on a funded dashboard
tests.summary:
Completed the requested registration using the name Kane Tester, email kaneowooco@mlyfo.app, and username kaneowooco.
Confirmed that @kaneowooco was available, then entered the requested password and created the account.
The new account opened successfully with the heading “Welcome, Kane” and a wallet balance of $500.00.

tests.name: New user can sign up and lands on a funded dashboard

Confirmed that @kaneowoqnh was available.
Created the account using the requested password.
Reached the welcome page for Kane, where the wallet balance displayed $500.00.

tests.name: Split a $236 bill four ways and get a link per person
tests.summary:
Created the requested split for “Kane dinner owoon8” with a total of $236, shared with zoya, kabir, and sofia.
Confirmed the split was divided among 4 people at $59.00 each.
Created the split and payment links successfully; it is listed as “1 of 4 paid,” with zoya, kabir, and sofia each owing $59.00 and each having a Copy link button.

tests.name: Shield blocks a look-alike of a saved contact's address
tests.summary:
You asked to sign in and check the provided Solana address on the Shield page.
The Shield page was opened, the address was entered, and the address check was submitted.
The result marked the address as “Blocked” and warned that it looks like Ada’s saved address but is not.

tests.name: Shield blocks a look-alike of a saved contact's address
tests.summary:
The requested Solana address was checked using the Shield page.
The address was identified as blocked.
The result also warned that it looks like Ada’s saved address but is not the same address.

tests.name: A payment over the spend limit waits for password confirmation
tests.summary:
You asked to send $150 to @ada for rent.
Entered “pay @ada 150 for rent” and selected the $150 payment option.
The confirmation screen showed that the payment exceeded the $100 per-payment limit and the $25 limit for new recipients.
Entered the provided password and confirmed the payment.
The payment was sent successfully: $150.00 to @ada.

tests.name: Shield flags a fake Phantom airdrop link as dangerous
tests.summary:
Checked the link https://phantorn-airdrop.app/claim as requested using the site’s Quick check option.
The scan completed and marked the link as Dangerous.
The listed reasons stated that the address imitates Phantom but is not the real site.

tests.name: Shield flags a fake Phantom airdrop link as dangerous
tests.summary:
Requested a quick safety check for https://phantorn-airdrop.app/claim.
Entered the link and ran the quick check.
The result marked the link as Dangerous and stated that the address imitates Phantom but is not the real site.

tests.name: Shield refuses to save a look-alike of a saved person
tests.summary:
Entered the name “Ada new” and the provided Solana address on the People page, then selected “Save person.”
The page reported that the address was not saved because it appeared to match Ada’s saved address.
“Ada new” was not added to the list of people.

tests.name: Paying a name that is both a saved person and another user asks who you meant
tests.summary:
Entered the payment request “pay semi 5 for coffee” in the message field.
Selected “Pay $5.00,” then chose “Your contact Semi” when asked which Semi to pay.
The payment was completed successfully, with the page confirming “Sent $5.00 to Semi.”
